terms.grammar: phrase: imāgō with the genitive of the pronoun: imāgō meī, tuī, nostrī
evidence: Cic. Lael. 23: tamquam exemplar aliquod intuētur suī (Lewis & Short s.v. exemplar)
terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for a selfie. A photo is imāgō phōtographica (see photo); a picture of oneself is imāgō suī, with the pronoun’s genitive as Cicero writes exemplar suī, an image of himself. A picture of us is imāgō nostrī.

sources: Lewis & Short: imago · Lewis & Short: exemplar
No source has a word for a selfie.
